classification: runtime initialization failure; mixed-topology numerical qualification not executed

production_defect.description: mmap MAP_SHARED fd offset0 receives system-page-aligned raw address; returning align_up(raw,65536) shifts file offset by delta. With exact region-sized memfd, returned full-region interval extends delta past EOF. No MAP_FIXED/remap restores file offset0.
production_defect.cuda_failure_causality: Strong source-level explanation consistent with observed registration failures. Raw mmap address was not logged, so per-failed-process alignment delta is not captured.

scope: No GPU relaunch or source edits. Evidence retained verbatim per host; top-level cleanup failure is secondary to primary_error.
